name: NFP 1-Hour Impact on EURUSD
description: Event-driven research study analyzing spot EURUSD price movements in the 1 hour immediately following US Non-Farm Payrolls releases. Measures average returns, distribution patterns, directional bias, and event-by-event performance over a 2-year lookback period.
source:
# NFP 1-Hour Impact on EURUSD
# Event-driven research analyzing EURUSD price movements after Non-Farm Payrolls releases

# Data source - 1H EURUSD
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Load NFP data (PAYEMS - All Employees, Total Nonfarm)
# economic_indicators indexes by ANNOUNCEMENT DATE (no forward-looking bias)
nfp_obs_date, nfp_value, nfp_revision = economic_indicators(series_id="PAYEMS")()

# Identify NFP release bars
# NFP is released at 8:30 AM ET on first Friday of month
# The economic_indicators returns data indexed by announcement date
is_nfp_release = is_valid(nfp_value)

# Calculate 1-hour return (current bar's return when NFP is released)
# Returns from open to close of the NFP announcement bar
hourly_return = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close)

# Filter returns to only NFP release bars
nfp_return = where(is_nfp_release, hourly_return)

# Calculate direction (positive/negative)
is_positive = nfp_return > 0
is_negative = nfp_return < 0

# Convert booleans to numeric for aggregation
positive_count = 1.0 if is_positive else 0.0
negative_count = 1.0 if is_negative else 0.0
event_count = 1.0 if is_nfp_release else 0.0

# Direction label for table
direction_label = "Up" if is_positive else ("Down" if is_negative else "Flat")

# Get timestamp for events
bar_timestamp = index()

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="NFP 1-Hour Impact Summary",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Average 1-Hour Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Loss Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Total Events", card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(nfp_return, positive_count, negative_count, event_count)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLES
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="All NFP Events",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="NFP Release Date", type=CardRenderType.TimestampFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="1-Hour Return (%)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="Direction", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Show Event", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    ),
    category="Events"
)(bar_timestamp, nfp_return, direction_label, is_nfp_release)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS
# =============================================================================

# Histogram of 1-hour returns after NFP
histogram(
    title="Distribution of 1-Hour EURUSD Returns After NFP",
    category="Analysis",
    bins=20,
    x_axis_label="1-Hour Return (%)",
    y_axis_label="Frequency",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=3,
    fill_color=Color.Blue
)(nfp_return)

# Scatter plot showing returns over time for each NFP event
# Using xy_scatter with bar index as x-axis
event_index = cumulative()(event_count)
xy_scatter(
    title="EURUSD 1-Hour Returns Following Each NFP Release",
    category="Analysis",
    x_axis_label="Event Number",
    y_axis_label="1-Hour Return (%)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="1-Hour Return", color=Color.Emerald, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ])
)(x=event_index, y_values=nfp_return)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="NFP Release",
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="NFP Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(title="1-Hour Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="Direction", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(nfp_value, nfp_return, direction_label, is_nfp_release)
